description: The source links contamination monitoring to a transformer-furnace malfunction at the Swan Hills Treatment Centre discovered October 16,1996. It describes release of PCB- and dioxin/furan-containing process gases and subsequent human-exposure assessment. XLSX datasets and column descriptions cover fish tissue 2000–2014 and deer tissue 1999–2014. The source reports eight fish and seven wild-game follow-up campaigns between 1997 and 2014. Food-consumption advice initially used a 30 km radius and was reduced to 15 km for wild game in 2012, informed by declining contamination. These are observations supporting assessment of a waste-facility failure and interventions; no current safety conclusion or causal numerical model is asserted. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
